editorial:
Imagine starting a new job at a quiet hospital, hoping for a fresh start after a rough time in your personal life. That is exactly where you find yourself with the main character, a young nurse who is just trying to move past her history of domestic abuse. The vibe is creepy from the start, as the empty hallways and dim lights make you feel like something is watching. You quickly realize that the night shift is not just about patients and paperwork, because a ghostly nurse from the past starts showing up, turning a normal work night into a total nightmare.

What really works here is how the movie mixes real-life trauma with supernatural scares. The acting feels natural, and the jump scares actually land well without feeling cheap. While the middle part slows down a bit, the ending picks up the speed and keeps you guessing. If you love ghost stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: You find out that the ghost nurse was a victim of the same kind of cruelty the main character faced. The twist reveals that the ghost was not trying to kill the new nurse, but was actually warning her about a living danger in the building. After a final scary confrontation, the main character overcomes her fear and finds peace. The ghost finally disappears once she knows the cycle of abuse is broken, leaving the hospital quiet again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural thrillers and ghost stories.
